title: Facade – Water Testing (PER)
activity: Hose and spray-bar water testing of the facade (witness point)
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Test location is one of the agreed locations (marked on the drawing/elevation)?
Everything in the test area complete – seals tooled, membranes lapped, sills and closures fitted?
Observer inside with a torch, internal finishes protected or not yet installed?
Water run at the joints, frame perimeters, sill ends and sliding door thresholds/corners?
No water inside – check the sill, frame corners, threshold, membrane laps and the slab edge?
Any leak marked, photographed and logged in Field before the area is closed up?
Failed location repaired and re-tested – and passed – before internal finishes go on?
